findings.original_v1_defect: reviews() requires repository-relative review paths but compiled() passes the actual closed compile-v2 authorization whose root/peer review paths are absolute. Known compile authority would necessarily be rejected before force calls.
findings.closed_by_v2: Only inherited compile provenance may use absolute paths under the active repository, converted through the existing canonical repository-relative validator. New replay authorization reviews remain repository-relative.

findings.original_v1_defect: all_checks and complete do not join driver.cleanup. A retained normal-close cleanup error could coexist with PASS while appearing under native_cleanup_errors.
findings.closed_by_v2: The unchanged retained native_cleanup_errors list now prevents both complete and all_stored_equation_checks_PASS whenever nonempty.

scope_read: Full v1 wrapper and wrapper protocol, relevant original fixed case and oracle definitions, actual closed compile receipt/authorization/review metadata, and exact v1-to-v2 source diff. Read-only source/metadata inspection, no numerical verification.
limits: This is source review for archival preservation, not an executed replay result.
Future replay requires a fresh exact implementation manifest, root and peer execution review, resource admission, and separate execution authority.
Synchronous subprocess waits/reads and sampled resource checks remain as described in the draft; no hard timeout, OS quota or adversarial parser qualification is claimed.
Stored-equation scope does not qualify physical state, work, materials, fret transport, audio, calibration, realism or realtime behavior.
